strings: After speaking with {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, the medicine cat has noticed that m_c is able to separate from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} one special cat once more.

m_c is finally able to get {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmate out of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head, no longer lost in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} thoughts of them, and allowing m_c to complete {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} duties again.
Finally, after a few moons, m_c is no longer lashing out at cats that get between {PRONOUN/m_c/object} and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} favorite cat.
